title: Interleaved dream-memory-think organism and graph-first intake
summary: Replace the one-way pipeline with recurrent local semantic dreaming, separate write-realization fanout, per-life memory checkpoints, narrow goal-conditioned thinking, and non-evidentiary thinker-to-dream agendas; require independent architecture deliberation before implementation.
system_thesis: An agent can turn its own action/outcome history into a progressively richer experiential world model when broad local dreaming, compressed parametric memory, narrow goal-conditioned thinking, and new experience form a recurrent audited loop.

context_files.purpose: Controlling graph, loop, ontology, benchmark ladder, and claim boundaries.
Durable record of the independent architecture, contract, and reviewer deliberation.

nodes.before: Dreaming was treated as a batch that should emit task-level structure.
nodes.after: Each dream operation adds, revises, reinforces, or questions one local semantic concept or edge with provenance.
nodes.rationale: The durable graph should grow incrementally across revisits rather than require the first dream to solve Blendyland.

nodes.before: Semantic claims and LoRA supervision forms were conflated.
nodes.after: Accepted semantic items receive separate canonical, QA, reverse, partial, situated, and contrast realizations plus touch plans.
nodes.rationale: Representation diversity changes write/read fidelity but must not manufacture beliefs or depth.

nodes.before: A terminal thinker answered after one frozen memory build.
nodes.after: A typed DFS-like thinker can retrieve, follow, revise, backtrack, release, defer, or request a later dream over an immutable checkpoint.
nodes.rationale: Task-specific composition belongs to the whole recurrent trajectory, not the first dream alone.

nodes.before: Design corrections could move directly from chat interpretation into code.
nodes.after: Graph, loop, claim, visibility, test, independent interpretation, cross-critique, consensus, and human scope are hash-bound before implementation.
nodes.rationale: Preserve the high-level thesis while engineering proceeds autonomously.

edges.after: Typed confusion and desire records may select later dream inputs but are never evidence.
edges.rationale: This is the recurrent convergence mechanism without answer laundering.

edges.after: Only live semantic items can source realizations; realizations cannot source semantics.
edges.rationale: Separate experiential structure from LoRA write format.

loops.after: experience -> dream -> realize -> checkpoint -> think -> non-evidentiary feedback -> later dream -> refreshed checkpoint -> rethink -> action/outcome experience
loops.trigger: New public experience, scheduled consolidation, or an unresolved thinker frontier.
loops.stop_condition: Release, defer at budget, explicit pass, or experiment-level matched call budget.
loops.rationale: The complete inference may emerge across organs and rounds.

loops.after: proposal -> two independent interpretations -> cross-critique -> adjudication -> human ratification -> scoped implementation -> tests -> independent review
loops.trigger: Any material human change to architecture, learning loop, benchmark, visibility, or headline claim.
loops.stop_condition: Human-approved exact scope or human-required pause.
loops.rationale: Autonomy should scale execution, not silently alter the scientific target.

claims.before: A strong first dream followed by LoRA and a terminal thinker is the intended full system.
claims.after: The test object is the recurrent dream-memory-think trajectory, and intelligence may be distributed across rounds and organs.
claims.evidence_needed: Matched recurrent controls showing intermediate transfer, later semantic growth, memory transport, task composition, and paired final behavior without hidden-answer visibility.

claims.after: Dreamed parametric memory may improve later agent decisions by compressing and reconnecting action/outcome experience beyond a fixed working window.
claims.evidence_needed: Per-life end-to-end action results against equal-compute no-memory, raw-context/RAG, text-memory, and non-recurrent controls across increasing lifetimes.

cells.reason: Eligible lived evidence.
Only accepted semantic claims, not raw history, source realizations.
Writer receives the frozen realization corpus.
Thinker must use the declared checkpoint interface in the memory arm.
Reporting may audit provenance after commitment.
Dreaming can extend prior local semantic items.
Live semantic items are the only realization sources.
The writer sees compiled training forms.
The thinker accesses memory through exact typed reads.
Committed structure is auditable.
It selects a local reactivation target only.
Feedback cannot be written as semantic content.
Feedback cannot be memorized directly.
It is mechanically projected from the frozen thinker trace.
Agenda utility and leakage are audited.
No answer-bearing oracle in the loop.
No answer-bearing training realization.
No answer leakage into weights.
The final goal exposes only the question.
Truth is revealed only for post-commit scoring.

acceptance_tests.setup: Attempt implementation authorization without two interpretations, cross-critique, consensus, or exact ratification.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The graph-first process is not actually enforced.

acceptance_tests.setup: Construct and adversarially mutate a two-round cyclic trace.
acceptance_tests.expected: Valid trace passes; phase, scope, provenance, and feedback-laundering mutations fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The recurrent organism cannot be audited causally.

acceptance_tests.setup: Increase paraphrase/QA realization count at fixed semantics.
acceptance_tests.expected: Write metrics change while semantic nodes, support, and depth remain fixed.

acceptance_tests.setup: Try to cite a thinker hypothesis, desire, or agenda as a dream premise.
acceptance_tests.expected: The artifact is rejected; only eligible public or prior semantic premises count.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Thinker feedback leaks answers into memory.

acceptance_tests.setup: Audit 1000 paired v0.3-R worlds with local-window, edge-removal, majority, and trained public-feature predictors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Oracle solves both twins; local windows and removed proofs fail; passive heldout lookup is at most majority plus .02.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The calibration game is solvable through unintended shortcuts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run matched no-feedback, agenda-feedback, and shuffled-feedback text organisms before LoRA.
acceptance_tests.expected: All arms have identical pre-feedback histories and budgets; any gain follows the typed return edge and survives paired scoring.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The recurrent link does not contribute beyond compute or leakage.

acceptance_tests.setup: Fresh architecture and benchmark reviewers receive frozen inputs and inspect the full causal chain.
acceptance_tests.expected: No blocking leakage, attribution, or implementation concern remains undispositioned.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The result is not ready for scientific interpretation.

human_boundary.decision_question: Authorize the adjudicated CPU implementation scope while keeping science GPU runs and claims blocked?
